description: For each pinned Python package, whether a prebuilt wheel exists for a target Python version and platform (Windows ARM, Alpine/musl, Linux ARM, macOS, a new Python version). Without one, pip builds from source, which usually fails without a compiler for packages with C extensions. For each that's missing, gives the nearest newer version that has a wheel, with that upgrade's risk.

limit.description: Max breaking changes shown for each suggested upgrade

platform.description: Target platform: manylinux_x86_64 or manylinux_aarch64 (glibc Linux, e.g. Debian/Ubuntu; assumes glibc 2.36, or give an exact tag like manylinux_2_28_x86_64), musllinux_x86_64 or musllinux_aarch64 (Alpine), win_amd64, win_arm64, win32, macosx_arm64, macosx_x86_64

requirements.description: requirements.txt contents or pip freeze output, one 'package==version' per line

name: wheel_check
title: Will pip find prebuilt wheels for this platform?
